description.text: Basic Energy cards in the Sun & Moon design, with a ©2017 line, in nine types. From Sun & Moon on, basic Energy in English sets was printed with no number at all and came in every expansion's booster packs. Sheen holo copies came in Shining Legends booster packs, and water web holo Lightning and Psychic Energy in the Rayquaza-GX and Ultra Necrozma Battle Arena Decks.
